title: Adi-khanda, part 5 (portion 13)
html:
Balya-lila (conclusion): Murari Gupta prostrates himself before the child Nimai, reveals to His parents that their son is Bhagavan, and tells Advaita Acharya about Him; Nimai and the boys hold a kirtana, and passing pandits join them; Murari tells Damodara Pandita of Vishvarupa's sannyasa; the grief of Shachi and Jagannatha; Vishvambhara promises to take care of His parents

এথা শচী-জগন্নাথ মেলি, পুত্রের দুলাল করি,
তুমি মোর সরবস ধন ।
যেখানে সেখানে যাই, যথা যে বা দুঃখ পাই,
দেখি পাশরিয়ে চান্দবদন ॥ ৪০০ ॥

ethā śacī-jagannātha meli, putrera dulāla kari,
tumi mora sarabasa dhana |
yekhāne sekhāne yāi, yathā ye bā duḥkha pāi,
dekhi pāśariẏe cāndabadana || 400 ||

etha — here; shachi-jagannatha meli — Shachi and Jagannatha together; putrera dulala kari — fondling the son; tumi mora sarabasa dhana — You are my whole wealth; yekhane sekhane yai — wherever I go; yatha ye ba duhkha pai — whatever sorrow I meet anywhere; dekhi — seeing; pasariye — I forget; chandavadana — the moonlike face

400Here, meanwhile, Shachi and Jagannatha together
are fondling their son: "You are my whole wealth!
Wherever I go, whatever sorrow I meet,
I look at Your moonlike face, and all is forgotten."

ইহা বলি দোঁহে মেলি, দুই গালে চুম্ব দেই,
কোলে করিবারে টানাটানি ।
হেনকালে মুরারি, সেইখানে বরাবরি,
আনন্দে না নিঃসরয়ে বাণী ॥ ৪০১ ॥

ihā bali doṁhe meli, dui gāle cumba dei,
kole karibāre ṭānāṭāni |
henakāle murāri, seikhāne barābari,
ānande nā niḥsaraẏe bāṇī || 401 ||

iha bali — saying this; donhe meli — both together; dui gale chumba dei — kiss on both cheeks; kole karibare tanatani — vie to take on the lap; henakale — at that time; murari — Murari; seikhane barabari — straight to that place; anande — from joy; na nihsaraye vani — no word comes out

401Saying this, both kiss Him on both cheeks
and vie with each other to take Him on their lap.
At that very moment Murari came straight there —
from joy he cannot utter a word.

দেখিয়া ত্রস্ত হৈয়া, শচী-জগন্নাথ গিয়া,
বৈদ্যেরে করিল অভ্যুত্থান ।
কারে কিছু না বলিল, আর সব পাশরিল,
দেখি গোরাচাঁদের বয়ান ॥ ৪০১ ॥

dekhiẏā trasta haiẏā, śacī-jagannātha giẏā,
baidyere karila abhyutthāna |
kāre kichu nā balila, āra saba pāśarila,
dekhi gorācāṁdera baẏāna || 401 ||

dekhiya — seeing; trasta haiya — hastily; shachi-jagannatha giya — Shachi and Jagannatha, going; vaidyere karila abhyutthana — rose to greet the vaidya; kare kichhu na balila — [he] said nothing to anyone; ara saba pasarila — and forgot all else; dekhi — seeing; gorachandera bayana — Gorachand's face

401aSeeing him, Shachi and Jagannatha hastily
rose and went to greet the vaidya;
but he said nothing to anyone and forgot everything else,
gazing at Gorachand's face.1

পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
ধারা বহে নয়ানের জলে ।
অরুণ-বরণ আঁখি, এ সে প্রেমার সাক্ষী,
গদগদ আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,
dhārā bahe naẏānera jale |
aruṇa-baraṇa āṁkhi, e se premāra sākṣī,
gadagada ādha-ādha bole || 393 ||

pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from foot to head; dhara vahe nayanera jale — streams of tears flow from the eyes; aruna-barana ankhi — reddened eyes; e se premara sakshi — these are the witnesses of prema; gadagada — choked; adha-adha bole — speaks half-words

393aHis whole body thrills with ecstasy
from head to foot; streams of tears flow from his eyes;
his reddened eyes — these are the witnesses of prema;
in a faltering voice he babbles half-words.

থির দাঁড়াইতে নারে, পড়িয়া চরণতলে,
পুনঃ পুনঃ করে পরণাম ।
দেখিয়া সে বিশ্বম্ভর, মায়ের কোল-ভিতর,
প্রবেশিল যেনক অজান ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

thira dāṁṛāite nāre, paṛiẏā caraṇatale,
punaḥ punaḥ kare paraṇāma |
dekhiẏā se biśbambhara, māẏera kola-bhitara,
prabeśila yenaka ajāna || 394 ||

thira danraite nare — cannot stand steady; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; punah punah kare paranama — bows again and again; dekhiya se vishvambhara — seeing this, Vishvambhara; mayera kola-bhitara praveshila — went into His mother's lap; yenaka ajana — as if unknowing

394aUnable to stand steady, he falls at His feet
and bows down again and again;
seeing this, Vishvambhara crept
into His mother's lap, as if He understood nothing.

শচী-জগন্নাথ বোলে, অহহ কি কৈলে কৈলে,
তোরে দেখি দেবতাসমান ।
আশীর্বাদযোগ্য তোরি, এ অতি বালক মোরি,
কি করিলে বড় অবিধান ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

śacī-jagannātha bole, ahaha ki kaile kaile,
tore dekhi debatāsamāna |
āśīrbādayogya tori, e ati bālaka mori,
ki karile baṛa abidhāna || 395 ||

shachi-jagannatha bole — Shachi and Jagannatha say; ahaha ki kaile kaile — ah, what have you done, done; tore dekhi devatasamana — we regard you as equal to a god; ashirvada-yogya tori — fit for your blessing; e ati balaka mori — this very little boy of mine; ki karile bada avidhana — what a great impropriety you have done

395aShachi and Jagannatha say: "Ah, what have you done, what have you done!
We regard you as equal to a god.
This very little boy is fit for your blessing —
what a great breach of custom you have committed!2

তোরে বলি শূদ্রমুনি, সর্বলোকে বাখানি,
মোর বালকে কি কৈলে অপরাধ ।
মো দিয়া যে হয় হউ, বাঢ়ু শিশু-পরমাউ,
চিরাউ বলি দেহ আশীর্বাদ ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

tore bali śūdramuni, sarbaloke bākhāni,
mora bālake ki kaile aparādha |
mo diẏā ye haẏa hau, bāṛhu śiśu-paramāu,
cirāu bali deha āśīrbāda || 396 ||

tore bali shudramuni — calling you a sage among shudras; sarvaloke vakhani — all people extol; mora balake ki kaile aparadha — what offence has my boy committed; mo diya ye haya hau — let whatever happens fall on me; badhu shishu-paramau — may the child's lifespan grow; chirau bali — saying "long life"; deha ashirvada — give blessing

396aAll people extol you, calling you a sage among the shudras;3
what offence has my boy committed against you?
Whatever may come, let it fall on me — may the child's years increase!
Bless Him, saying, 'Live long!'"

ইহা বলি হাথে ধরি, প্রণতি মিনতি করি,
শচী আর মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
হাসি বোলে মুরারি, এনা পুত্র তোহারি,
দেব-দেব-দেব বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

ihā bali hāthe dhari, praṇati minati kari,
śacī āra miśra purandara |
hāsi bole murāri, enā putra tohāri,
deba-deba-deba biśbambhara || 397 ||

iha bali — saying this; hathe dhari — holding the hands; pranati minati kari — bowing and entreating; shachi ara mishra purandara — Shachi and Mishra Purandara; hasi bole murari — smiling, Murari says; ena putra tohari — this son of yours; deva-deva-deva — God of the god of gods; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara

397aSaying this, holding his hands, bowing and entreating,
[stand] Shachi and Mishra Purandara;
and Murari, smiling, says: "This son of yours,
Vishvambhara, is the God of the god of gods.

বালক লালিহ কাছে, ইহা ত জানিবে পাছে,
তোর সম নাহি ভাগ্যবান্ ।
সম্বরি রাখিহ মনে, এই মোর বচনে,
বিশ্বম্ভর সেই ভগবান্ ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

bālaka lāliha kāche, ihā ta jānibe pāche,
tora sama nāhi bhāgyabān |
sambari rākhiha mane, ei mora bacane,
biśbambhara sei bhagabān || 398 ||

balaka laliha kachhe — cherish the boy near you; iha ta janibe pachhe — this you will know later; tora sama nahi bhagyavan — none is as fortunate as you; sambari rakhiha mane — keep it guarded in your heart; ei mora vachane — these words of mine; vishvambhara sei bhagavan — Vishvambhara is that very Bhagavan

398aCherish the boy, keep Him close to you — later you will understand this;
no one is as fortunate as you.
Keep these words of mine treasured in your heart, guarding the secret:
Vishvambhara is that very Bhagavan."

ইহা বলি গুপ্তবেজা, না করিল আন-চর্চা,
চলি গেলা হরিষ-অন্তর ।
আনন্দে ভরল হিয়া, গোরাপদ দেখিয়া,
গেলা যথা আচার্যের ঘর ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

ihā bali guptabejā, nā karila āna-carcā,
cali gelā hariṣa-antara |
ānande bharala hiẏā, gorāpada dekhiẏā,
gelā yathā ācāryera ghara || 399 ||

iha bali — saying this; guptabeja — Gupta the vaidya; na karila ana-charcha — spoke of nothing else; chali gela harisha-antara — went away with a joyful heart; anande bharala hiya — the heart filled with bliss; gorapada dekhiya — having seen Gora's feet; gela yatha acharyera ghara — went to the house of the Acharya

399aSaying this, Gupta the vaidya spoke of nothing else
and went away with a joyful heart;
his heart overflowing with bliss, having seen Gora's feet,
he went to the house of the Acharya.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাম, সেই সর্বগুণধাম,
সেই সর্বজন-শিক্ষাগুরু ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, মুরারি বিনতি করে,
তুমি সর্বভক্ত-কল্পতরু ॥ ৪০০ ॥

adbaita-ācārya nāma, sei sarbaguṇadhāma,
sei sarbajana-śikṣāguru |
paṛiẏā caraṇatale, murāri binati kare,
tumi sarbabhakta-kalpataru || 400 ||

advaita-acharya nama — His name is Advaita Acharya; sei sarvaguna-dhama — He is the abode of all virtues; sei sarvajana-shiksha-guru — He is the teacher of all people; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; murari vinati kare — Murari humbly says; tumi sarvabhakta-kalpataru — you are the wish-fulfilling tree of all devotees

400aHis name is Advaita Acharya: He is the abode of all virtues,
He is the teacher of all people.
Falling at His feet, Murari humbly says:
"You are the wish-fulfilling tree for all devotees.

দেখিলাঙ অদ্ভুত, মিশ্র-পুরন্দর-সুত,
নিমাই পণ্ডিত বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বাল্যক্রীড়া করে রঙ্গে, সকল শিশুর সঙ্গে,
চরিত্র দেখিলুঁ লোকোত্তর ॥ ৪০১ ॥

dekhilāṅa adbhuta, miśra-purandara-suta,
nimāi paṇḍita biśbambhara |
bālyakrīṛā kare raṅge, sakala śiśura saṅge,
caritra dekhiluṁ lokottara || 401 ||

dekhilanga adbhuta — I have seen a wonder; mishra-purandara-suta — the son of Mishra Purandara; nimai pandita vishvambhara — Nimai Pandita Vishvambhara; balya-krida kare range — merrily plays childhood games; sakala shishura sange — with all the boys; charitra dekhilun lokottara — I have seen deeds beyond the human

401bI have seen a wonder: the son of Mishra Purandara,
Nimai Pandita Vishvambhara,
merrily plays His childhood games with all the boys —
I have seen deeds beyond the human."

ইহা শুনি দ্বিজমণি, হুহুঙ্কার করে ধ্বনি,
পুলকে ভরল সব অঙ্গ ।
রহস্য রহস্য এই, তোমারে নিভৃতে কই,
সেই ব্রহ্ম রসিক শ্রীঅঙ্গ ॥ ৪০২ ॥

ihā śuni dbijamaṇi, huhuṅkāra kare dhbani,
pulake bharala saba aṅga |
rahasya rahasya ei, tomāre nibhṛte kai,
sei brahma rasika śrīaṅga || 402 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; dvijamani — the jewel of the twice-born; huhunkara kare dhvani — thunders "hum-hum"; pulake bharala saba anga — the whole body filled with thrills; rahasya rahasya ei — this is a secret, a secret; tomare nibhrite kai — I tell you in private; sei brahma — He is that Brahman; rasika — the relisher of rasa; shri-anga — of beautiful form

402Hearing this, the jewel of the twice-born thundered "hum-hum";
His whole body filled with thrills of ecstasy:
"This is a secret, a secret — I tell you in private:
He is that very Brahman, the Relisher of rasa, in a beautiful form."4

ইহা বলি কোলাকুলি, দুজনে আনন্দে ভুলি,
বেকত না করে বিশোয়াস ।
অখিল-ভুবনপতি, কৃপায়ে আইলা ক্ষিতি,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

ihā bali kolākuli, dujane ānande bhuli,
bekata nā kare biśoẏāsa |
akhila-bhubanapati, kṛpāẏe āilā kṣiti,
guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 403 ||

iha bali — saying this; kolakuli — embraced; dujane anande bhuli — both forgetting themselves in joy; bekata na kare vishoyasa — do not disclose their conviction; akhila-bhuvanapati — the Lord of all the worlds; kripaye aila kshiti — came to earth out of mercy; guna gaya e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa sings His glories

403Saying this, they embraced, both forgetting themselves in joy,
but they do not disclose their conviction [to others].
The Lord of all the worlds has come to earth out of mercy —
His glories are sung by this Lochana Dasa.

Raga bhatiyari; disha (numbered as a couplet in the edition):

হরি হরি বোল চারিদিগ্ ভরি শুনি ।
হাতে তালি জয় জয় নাচে দ্বিজমণি ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

hari hari bola cāridig bhari śuni |
hāte tāli jaẏa jaẏa nāce dbijamaṇi || 404 ||

hari hari bola — the cry "Hari, Hari"; charidig bhari shuni — is heard filling the four directions; hate tali — clapping hands; jaya jaya — "jaya, jaya"; nache dvijamani — the jewel of the twice-born dances

404The cry "Hari! Hari!" is heard, filling all the directions;
clapping His hands, [crying] "Jaya, jaya!", the jewel of the twice-born dances.

বয়স্য বালক সব করি একমেলা ।
হরিগুণ-কীর্তন ভাল পাতিয়াছে খেলা ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

baẏasya bālaka saba kari ekamelā |
hariguṇa-kīrtana bhāla pātiẏāche khelā || 405 ||

vayasya balaka saba — all the boys of His age; kari ekamela — gathering together; hariguna-kirtana — kirtana of Hari's glories; bhala patiyachhe khela — has started a fine game

405Gathering together all the boys of His age,
He has started a fine game — a kirtana of Hari's glories.

চৌদিকে বালক বেঢ়ি হরি হরি বোলে ।
আনন্দে বিভোর প্রভু ভূমে গড়ি বুলে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

caudike bālaka beṛhi hari hari bole |
ānande bibhora prabhu bhūme gaṛi bule || 406 ||

chaudike balaka bedhi — the boys surrounding on all sides; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari"; anande vibhora prabhu — the Lord overwhelmed with joy; bhume gadi bule — rolls on the ground

406Surrounding Him on all sides, the boys cry "Hari, Hari!"
and the Lord, overwhelmed with joy, rolls on the ground.

বোল বোল বলি ডাকে মেঘগম্ভীর-স্বরে ।
আইস আইস বলিয়া বালক কোলে করে ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

bola bola bali ḍāke meghagambhīra-sbare |
āisa āisa baliẏā bālaka kole kare || 407 ||

bola bola bali dake — calls, "Sing, sing!"; meghagambhira-svare — in a voice deep as thunder; aisa aisa baliya — saying "come, come"; balaka kole kare — embraces the boys

407"Sing, sing!" He calls in a voice deep as thunder,
and saying, "Come here, come!", He embraces the boys.

শ্রীঅঙ্গ-পরশে বালক পাশরে আপনা ।
ফাঁফরে পড়িয়া দেখি বালকের কান্দনা ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

śrīaṅga-paraśe bālaka pāśare āpanā |
phāṁphare paṛiẏā dekhi bālakera kāndanā || 408 ||

shri-anga-parashe — at the touch of the divine body; balaka pasare apana — the boy forgets himself; phanphare padiya — overwhelmed; dekhi balakera kandana — see the boy's weeping

408At the touch of His divine body a boy forgets himself —
see how the boy, overwhelmed, is weeping!

আপাদমস্তকে পুলক অশ্রুধারা গলে ।
করতালি দিয়া বালক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

āpādamastake pulaka aśrudhārā gale |
karatāli diẏā bālaka hari hari bole || 409 ||

apada-mastake pulaka — thrills from foot to head; ashrudhara gale — streams of tears flow; karatali diya — clapping hands; balaka hari hari bole — the boy cries "Hari, Hari"

409From head to foot — thrills of ecstasy; streams of tears flow;
clapping his hands, the boy cries "Hari, Hari!"

চৌদিকে বালক বেঢ়ি মাঝে গোরাসিংহ ।
মধুময় কমলে যেন বেঢ়িল মত্ত ভৃঙ্গ ॥ ৪১০ ॥

caudike bālaka beṛhi mājhe gorāsiṃha |
madhumaẏa kamale yena beṛhila matta bhṛṅga || 410 ||

chaudike balaka bedhi — boys surrounding on all sides; majhe gorasimha — in the middle the lion Gora; madhumaya kamale — a honey-filled lotus; yena bedhila matta bhringa — as if intoxicated bees had encircled

410The boys surround Him on all sides, and in the middle is the lion Gora,
as if intoxicated bees had encircled a honey-filled lotus.

হেনকালে সেই পথে দুই চারি পণ্ডিত ।
বিশ্বম্ভর খেলেন দেখিল আচম্বিত ॥ ৪১১ ॥

henakāle sei pathe dui cāri paṇḍita |
biśbambhara khelena dekhila ācambita || 411 ||

henakale — at that time; sei pathe — on that road; dui chari pandita — a few pandits; vishvambhara khelena — Vishvambhara playing; dekhila achambita — suddenly saw

411At that time a few pandits were passing along that road
and suddenly saw Vishvambhara's game.

অপরূপ দেখি গোরা-বালকের খেলা ।
বনফুল গাঁথিয়া সভার গলে মালা ॥ ৪১২ ॥

aparūpa dekhi gorā-bālakera khelā |
banaphula gāṁthiẏā sabhāra gale mālā || 412 ||

aparupa dekhi — they see the wonderful; gora-balakera khela — game of the boy Gora; vanaphula ganthiya — strung of wildflowers; sabhara gale mala — garlands on everyone's neck

412They see the wonderful game of the boy Gora:
on everyone's neck are garlands strung of wildflowers;

হরি হরি বোলে মুখে করে করতালি ।
আনন্দে নাচিয়া বুলে মাঝে গোরাহরি ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

hari hari bole mukhe kare karatāli |
ānande nāciẏā bule mājhe gorāhari || 413 ||

hari hari bole mukhe — with their mouths cry "Hari, Hari"; kare karatali — clap hands; anande nachiya bule — dances about in joy; majhe gorahari — in the middle Gorahari

413with their mouths they cry "Hari, Hari!" and clap their hands,
and in the middle Gorahari dances about in joy.

আপনা পাশরি পণ্ডিত সভে আইল মেলে ।
করতালি দিয়া তারা হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

āpanā pāśari paṇḍita sabhe āila mele |
karatāli diẏā tārā hari hari bole || 414 ||

apana pasari — forgetting themselves; pandita sabhe aila mele — all the pandits joined; karatali diya — clapping hands; tara hari hari bole — they cry "Hari, Hari"

414Forgetting themselves, all the pandits joined them,
and, clapping their hands, they too cried "Hari, Hari!"

যে বা আসে যায় পথে দেখি হয় ভোলা ।
কাঁখেতে কলসী করি চাহে নারীগুলা ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

ye bā āse yāẏa pathe dekhi haẏa bholā |
kāṁkhete kalasī kari cāhe nārīgulā || 415 ||

ye ba ase yaya pathe — whoever comes or goes along the road; dekhi haya bhola — is entranced at the sight; kankhete kalasi kari — with water-pots on their hips; chahe narigula — the women gaze

415Whoever comes or goes along the road is entranced at the sight;
women with water-pots on their hips stand and gaze.

হরি হরি বোল শুনি জয় জয় নাদ ।
শুনিঞা ধাইল কেহো দেখিবারে সাধ ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

hari hari bola śuni jaẏa jaẏa nāda |
śuniñā dhāila keho dekhibāre sādha || 416 ||

hari hari bola shuni — hearing "Hari, Hari"; jaya jaya nada — shouts of "jaya, jaya"; shuniya dhaila keho — hearing, some ran; dekhibare sadha — eager to see

416Hearing the cries of "Hari, Hari!" and the shouts of "Jaya, jaya!",
some came running, eager to see.

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী আইলা আচম্বিতে ।
দেখিল আপন পুত্র নিমাই আর পণ্ডিতে ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

e bola śuniñā śacī āilā ācambite |
dekhila āpana putra nimāi āra paṇḍite || 417 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing these cries; shachi aila achambite — Shachi suddenly came; dekhila apana putra nimai — saw her own son Nimai; ara pandite — and the pandits

417Hearing these cries, Shachi suddenly came
and saw her own son Nimai and the pandits.

পুত্র পুত্র বলি শচী নিমাই কৈল কোলে ।
সভারে দেখিয়া সে নিষ্ঠুর বাণী বোলে ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

putra putra bali śacī nimāi kaila kole |
sabhāre dekhiẏā se niṣṭhura bāṇī bole || 418 ||

putra putra bali — saying "son, son"; shachi nimai kaila kole — Shachi took Nimai in her arms; sabhare dekhiya — looking at all; se nishthura vani bole — she speaks harsh words

418Crying "My son, my son!", Shachi took Nimai in her arms,
and, looking at them all, she speaks harsh words:

এমত বেভার সব পণ্ডিত-সভায় ।
পর-পুত পাগল করি উন্মত্ত নাচায় ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

emata bebhāra saba paṇḍita-sabhāẏa |
para-puta pāgala kari unmatta nācāẏa || 419 ||

emata bebhara — such conduct; saba pandita-sabhaya — of the whole assembly of pandits; para-puta pagala kari — driving someone else's son mad; unmatta nachaya — make him dance like a madman

419"Fine conduct for a whole assembly of pandits!
You have driven someone else's son mad and make him dance like a lunatic!"

কর্কশ কথায় সভার হইল চেতন ।
কি কৈল কি কৈল বলি গণে মনে মন ॥ ৪২০ ॥

karkaśa kathāẏa sabhāra haila cetana |
ki kaila ki kaila bali gaṇe mane mana || 420 ||

karkasha kathaya — at the harsh words; sabhara haila chetana — all came to their senses; ki kaila ki kaila bali — saying "what have we done, what have we done"; gane mane mana — each reckons within himself

420At her harsh words they all came to their senses:
"What have we done, what have we done?" each thinks to himself.

বিশ্বম্ভরে লঞা গেলা বিশ্বম্ভরের মাতা ।
আনন্দে লোচন কহে গোরাগুণগাথা ॥ ৪২১ ॥

biśbambhare lañā gelā biśbambharera mātā |
ānande locana kahe gorāguṇagāthā || 421 ||

vishvambhare lana gela — took Vishvambhara away; vishvambharera mata — Vishvambhara's mother; anande lochana kahe — in joy Lochana tells; goraguna-gatha — the glories of Gora

421Vishvambhara's mother took Vishvambhara away;
in joy Lochana tells the glories of Gora.

Raga sindhura; disha: "A spotless moon has risen in Nadia!"

এইখানে এক কথা কহিব এখন ।
মুরারিতে দামোদরে যে হৈল কথন ॥ ৪২২ ॥

eikhāne eka kathā kahiba ekhana |
murārite dāmodare ye haila kathana || 422 ||

eikhane — here; eka katha kahiba ekhana — I shall now tell a story; murarite damodare — between Murari and Damodara; ye haila kathana — the conversation that took place

422Now here I shall tell a story —
the conversation that took place between Murari and Damodara.5

মুরারিকে পুছিলা পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
এক নিবেদঙ চির বেদনা অন্তর ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

murārike puchilā paṇḍita dāmodara |
eka nibedaṅa cira bedanā antara || 423 ||

murarike puchhila — asked Murari; pandita damodara — Damodara Pandita; eka nivedanga — I submit one [request]; chira vedana antara — a long-standing pain of the heart

423Damodara Pandita asked Murari:
"I make one request — it is a long-standing pain in my heart.

কহ কহ গুপ্তবেজা পুছোঁ তোর ঠাঞি ।
কতি গেলা বিশ্বরূপ ঠাকুরের ভাই ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

kaha kaha guptabejā puchoṁ tora ṭhāñi |
kati gelā biśbarūpa ṭhākurera bhāi || 424 ||

kaha kaha — tell, tell; guptabeja — Gupta the vaidya; puchhon tora thani — I ask you; kati gela — where did he go; vishvarupa — Vishvarupa; thakurera bhai — the Thakura's brother

424Tell me, tell me, Gupta the vaidya, I ask you:
where did Vishvarupa, the Thakura's brother, go?

তাহার চরিত্র কিছু পুছোঁ মো সাদরে ।
কহয়ে মুরারি বড় হরিষ অন্তরে ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

tāhāra caritra kichu puchoṁ mo sādare |
kahaẏe murāri baṛa hariṣa antare || 425 ||

tahara charitra kichhu — something of his life; puchhon mo sadare — I ask with love; kahaye murari — Murari says; bada harisha antare — with great joy in his heart

425With love I ask you about his life."
And Murari, with great joy in his heart, replies:

শুন শুন দামোদর পণ্ডিত-প্রধান ।
যে জানোঁ মো কহোঁ কিছু তোর বিদ্যমান ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

śuna śuna dāmodara paṇḍita-pradhāna |
ye jānoṁ mo kahoṁ kichu tora bidyamāna || 426 ||

shuna shuna — listen, listen; damodara pandita-pradhana — Damodara, foremost of pandits; ye janon mo — what I know; kahon kichhu — I shall tell; tora vidyamana — in your presence

426"Listen, listen, Damodara, foremost of pandits:
what I know I shall tell you.

বিশ্বম্ভর-জ্যেষ্ঠ বিশ্বরূপ গুণধাম ।
কি কহিব তার গুণ-চরিত্র-বাখান ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

biśbambhara-jyeṣṭha biśbarūpa guṇadhāma |
ki kahiba tāra guṇa-caritra-bākhāna || 427 ||

vishvambhara-jyeshtha — Vishvambhara's elder brother; vishvarupa gunadhama — Vishvarupa, abode of virtues; ki kahiba — what shall I say; tara guna-charitra-vakhana — the description of his virtues and deeds

427Vishvambhara's elder brother, Vishvarupa, was an abode of virtues;6
how can I describe his virtues and deeds!

অল্পকালে সর্বশাস্ত্র জানয় সকল ।
ধর্মে তৎপর বুদ্ধি সংসারে বিরল ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

alpakāle sarbaśāstra jānaẏa sakala |
dharme tatpara buddhi saṃsāre birala || 428 ||

alpakale — in a short time; sarvashastra janaya sakala — knew all the shastras; dharme tatpara buddhi — mind devoted to dharma; samsare virala — averse to worldly life

428In a short time he mastered all the shastras;
his mind was devoted to dharma and averse to worldly life.

স্বচ্ছন্দ-হৃদয় দ্বিজ-দেব-গুরু-ভক্ত ।
পিতা-মাতার সেবা করে অতি অনুরক্ত ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

sbacchanda-hṛdaẏa dbija-deba-guru-bhakta |
pitā-mātāra sebā kare ati anurakta || 429 ||

svachchhanda-hridaya — of pure (open) heart; dvija-deva-guru-bhakta — devoted to brahmanas, gods and guru; pita-matara seva kare — serves father and mother; ati anurakta — with great love

429Pure of heart, devoted to brahmanas, gods and guru,
he served his father and mother with great love.

বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত জানে সর্বধর্ম-মর্ম ।
বিষ্ণুভক্তি বিনু সে না করে কোন কর্ম ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

bedānta-siddhānta jāne sarbadharma-marma |
biṣṇubhakti binu se nā kare kona karma || 430 ||

vedanta-siddhanta jane — knows the conclusions of Vedanta; sarvadharma-marma — the essence of every dharma; vishnubhakti vinu — without devotion to Vishnu; se na kare kona karma — he does no act at all

430He knew the conclusions of Vedanta, the essence of every dharma;
without devotion to Vishnu he did no act at all.

সর্বলোক-প্রিয় সে পরম মহাসিদ্ধি ।
অন্তরে বৈরাগ্য তত্ত্বজ্ঞানে নিষ্ঠ বুদ্ধি ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

sarbaloka-priẏa se parama mahāsiddhi |
antare bairāgya tattbajñāne niṣṭha buddhi || 431 ||

sarvaloka-priya se — he is beloved by all; parama mahasiddhi — of supreme perfection; antare vairagya — detachment at heart; tattvajnane nishtha buddhi — mind fixed in the knowledge of truth

431Beloved by all, he had attained the highest perfection;
detached at heart, his mind was fixed in the knowledge of truth.

সমাধ্যায়ি-সনে কথা পুথি বামহাতে ।
জগন্নাথ পিতায়ে দেখিলা রাজপথে ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

samādhyāẏi-sane kathā puthi bāmahāte |
jagannātha pitāẏe dekhilā rājapathe || 432 ||

samadhyayi-sane katha — talking with fellow students; puthi vamahate — a book in the left hand; jagannatha pitaye — the father Jagannatha; dekhila rajapathe — saw on the main road

432One day his father Jagannatha saw him on the main road,
talking with his fellow students, a book in his left hand.

ষোড়শ বরিষ পুত্র ভেল বয়ঃক্রম ।
বিবাহের যোগ্য রূপ-যৌবন-সম্পন্ন ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

ṣoṛaśa bariṣa putra bhela baẏaḥkrama |
bibāhera yogya rūpa-yaubana-sampanna || 433 ||

shodasha barisha — sixteen years; putra bhela vayahkrama — became the son's age; vivahera yogya — fit for marriage; rupa-yauvana-sampanna — endowed with beauty and youth

433The son had reached the age of sixteen;
he was fit for marriage, endowed with beauty and youth.

এই মনঃকথা পিতা হৃদয়ে করিল ।
বিশ্বরূপ-যোগ্য কন্যা মনে বিচারিল ॥ ৪৩৪ ॥

ei manaḥkathā pitā hṛdaẏe karila |
biśbarūpa-yogya kanyā mane bicārila || 434 ||

ei manahkatha — this wish; pita hridaye karila — the father harboured in his heart; vishvarupa-yogya kanya — brides worthy of Vishvarupa; mane vicharila — considered in his mind

434The father harboured this wish in his heart
and began to consider brides worthy of Vishvarupa.

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে দ্বিজ আইলা নিজঘর ।
বিশ্বরূপ-বিভা দিব চিন্তিত অন্তর ॥ ৪৩৫ ॥

cintite cintite dbija āilā nijaghara |
biśbarūpa-bibhā diba cintita antara || 435 ||

chintite chintite — thinking and thinking; dvija aila nijaghara — the brahmana came home; vishvarupa-vibha diba — "I will get Vishvarupa married"; chintita antara — preoccupied heart

435Deep in thought, the brahmana came home,
his heart full of one thought: 'I will get Vishvarupa married.'

কথোক্ষণে বিশ্বরূপ দ্বিজ আইলা ঘর ।
সুবিস্মিত পিতা দেখি বুঝিল অন্তর ॥ ৪৩৬ ॥

kathokṣaṇe biśbarūpa dbija āilā ghara |
subismita pitā dekhi bujhila antara || 436 ||

kathokshane — after a while; vishvarupa dvija aila ghara — the brahmana Vishvarupa came home; suvismita pita dekhi — seeing his father lost in thought (lit. "much amazed"); bujhila antara — understood his heart

436Soon the brahmana Vishvarupa also came home,
and, seeing his father lost in thought, he understood what was in his heart.

তবে সেইমতে বিশ্বরূপ দ্বিজবর্য ।
সুবিস্মিত পিতা দেখি বুঝিলেন কার্য ॥ ৪৩৭ ॥

tabe seimate biśbarūpa dbijabarya |
subismita pitā dekhi bujhilena kārya || 437 ||

tabe seimate — so; vishvarupa dvijavarya — Vishvarupa, the best of brahmanas; suvismita pita dekhi — seeing his father lost in thought; bujhilena karya — understood the matter

437So the best of brahmanas, Vishvarupa,
seeing his father lost in thought, understood the matter.

অন্তরে জানিল মোর বিবাহের তরে ।
চিন্তিত হইলা দোঁহে কার্য করিবারে ॥ ৪৩৮ ॥

antare jānila mora bibāhera tare |
cintita hailā doṁhe kārya karibāre || 438 ||

antare janila — understood in his heart; mora vivahera tare — for my marriage; chintita haila donhe — both have become anxious; karya karibare — to accomplish the matter

438He understood in his heart: 'It is for my marriage —
they are both anxious how to arrange it.

বিবাহ করিব আমি নহে ত উচিত ।
নহে বা জননী দুঃখ পাবে বিপরীত ॥ ৪৩৯ ॥

bibāha kariba āmi nahe ta ucita |
nahe bā jananī duḥkha pābe biparīta || 439 ||

vivaha kariba ami — for me to marry; nahe ta uchita — is not proper; nahe ba — or else; janani duhkha pave — mother will suffer grief; viparita — contrary [to her wish]

439For me to marry is not proper;
and if I do not, mother will grieve: it will go against her wish.'

এই মনে অনুমানি রাত্রি-সুপ্রভাতে ।
বাহির হইয়া গেলা পুথি বামহাতে ॥ ৪৪০ ॥

ei mane anumāni rātri-suprabhāte |
bāhira haiẏā gelā puthi bāmahāte || 440 ||

ei mane anumani — reasoning thus; ratri-suprabhate — at daybreak; bahira haiya gela — went out; puthi vamahate — with a book in his left hand

440Having reasoned thus, at daybreak
he went out of the house with a book in his left hand,

গঙ্গাজল-সন্তরণ করি পার হৈলা ।
গত-মাত্র মহাশয় সন্ন্যাস করিলা ॥ ৪৪১ ॥

gaṅgājala-santaraṇa kari pāra hailā |
gata-mātra mahāśaẏa sannyāsa karilā || 441 ||

gangajala-santarana kari — swimming across the Ganga's waters; para haila — crossed over; gata-matra — as soon as he had gone; mahashaya — the great soul; sannyasa karila — took sannyasa

441swam across the waters of the Ganga to the other bank,
and, as soon as he had gone, the great soul took sannyasa.

Raga pathamanjari

তৃতীয়-প্রহর বেলা, কেনে পুত্র না আইলা,
পিতা মাতা চিন্তিত-হৃদয় ।
জগন্নাথ খোঁজ করে, চাহে প্রতি ঘরে ঘরে,
না পাইল আপন তনয় ॥ ৪৪২ ॥

tṛtīẏa-prahara belā, kene putra nā āilā,
pitā mātā cintita-hṛdaẏa |
jagannātha khoṁja kare, cāhe prati ghare ghare,
nā pāila āpana tanaẏa || 442 ||

tritiya-prahara vela — the third watch of the day; kene putra na aila — why has the son not come; pita mata chintita-hridaya — father and mother anxious at heart; jagannatha khoja kare — Jagannatha searches; chahe prati ghare ghare — looks into every house; na paila apana tanaya — did not find his son

442The third watch of the day has come — why has our son not returned?
The hearts of father and mother are full of anxiety.
Jagannatha searches, looks into house after house,
and did not find his son.

জনে জনে কানাকানি, কার্য হৈল জানাজানি,
বিশ্বরূপ-সন্ন্যাসকরণ ।
তো-কাণি মো-কাণি কথা, শুনি জগন্নাথ পিতা,
আচম্বিতে হরিল চেতন ॥ ৪৪৩ ॥

jane jane kānākāni, kārya haila jānājāni,
biśbarūpa-sannyāsakaraṇa |
to-kāṇi mo-kāṇi kathā, śuni jagannātha pitā,
ācambite harila cetana || 443 ||

jane jane kanakani — people whisper to one another; karya haila janajani — the matter became known; vishvarupa-sannyasa-karana — Vishvarupa's taking sannyasa; to-kani mo-kani katha — talk passed from ear to ear; shuni jagannatha pita — hearing, the father Jagannatha; achambite harila chetana — suddenly lost consciousness

443People whisper to one another, and the matter became known:
Vishvarupa had taken sannyasa.
Hearing the news passed from ear to ear,
the father Jagannatha suddenly lost consciousness.

তবে শচীদেবী শুনি, মূর্ছিত পড়িলা ভূমি,
অন্ধকার হৈল ত্রিজগত ।
বিশ্বরূপ বলি ডাকে, আইস পুত্র দেখি তোকে,
কি লাগিয়া হইলা বিরক্ত ॥ ৪৪৪ ॥

tabe śacīdebī śuni, mūrchita paṛilā bhūmi,
andhakāra haila trijagata |
biśbarūpa bali ḍāke, āisa putra dekhi toke,
ki lāgiẏā hailā birakta || 444 ||

tabe shachidevi shuni — then Shachi-devi, hearing; murchhita padila bhumi — fell senseless to the ground; andhakara haila trijagata — the three worlds became dark; vishvarupa bali dake — calls "Vishvarupa!"; aisa putra dekhi toke — come, son, let me see you; ki lagiya haila virakta — why have you renounced

444Then Shachi-devi too, hearing it, fell senseless to the ground —
the three worlds became dark.
She calls, "Vishvarupa! Come, my son, let me see you!
Why have you renounced the world?

সে হেন সুন্দর গা, সে হেন সুন্দর পা,
কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
প্রহরেক ভোখ তুমি, তিলেক সহিতে নার,
আখটি করিবে আর কাথে ॥ ৪৪৫ ॥

se hena sundara gā, se hena sundara pā,
kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |
prahareka bhokha tumi, tileka sahite nāra,
ākhaṭi karibe āra kāthe || 445 ||

se hena sundara ga — such a beautiful body; se hena sundara pa — such beautiful feet; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will you walk along the roads; praharaka bhokha tumi — the hunger of one watch you; tileka sahite nara — could not bear even a moment; akhati karibe ara kathe — with whom will you now be fussy

445Such a beautiful body, such beautiful feet —
how will you walk along the roads?
You could not bear the hunger of a single watch —
with whom will you now be fussy?

পড়িবারে যাও পুতে, সোয়াস্থ না পাঙ চিতে,
বেলি চাহোঁ তখনে তখন ।
স্নান করিবারে যাও, তথা স্থির নাহি পাঙ,
বিশ্বরূপ আসিবে এখন ॥ ৪৪৬ ॥

paṛibāre yāo pute, soẏāstha nā pāṅa cite,
beli cāhoṁ takhane takhana |
snāna karibāre yāo, tathā sthira nāhi pāṅa,
biśbarūpa āsibe ekhana || 446 ||

padibare yao pute — when you go to study, son; soyastha na panga chite — I find no ease in my heart; beli chahon takhane takhana — I look at the time again and again; snana karibare yao — when you go to bathe; tatha sthira nahi panga — then too I cannot keep still; vishvarupa asibe ekhana — "Vishvarupa will come now"

446When you went to study, son, my heart found no rest —
I kept looking at the time again and again;
when you went to bathe, even then I could not keep still:
'Vishvarupa will come any moment now.'

তুমি মা বলিয়া ডাক, সেই ধন লাখো লাখ,
মুখ চাঞা পাশরোঁ আপনা ।
না জানি কি দুঃখ পাঞা, মোর মুখে আগি দিয়া,
সন্ন্যাস করিলি দীনপনা ॥ ৪৪৭ ॥

tumi mā baliẏā ḍāka, sei dhana lākho lākha,
mukha cāñā pāśaroṁ āpanā |
nā jāni ki duḥkha pāñā, mora mukhe āgi diẏā,
sannyāsa karili dīnapanā || 447 ||

tumi ma baliya daka — that you call "mother"; sei dhana lakho lakha — that is wealth of hundreds of thousands; mukha chana — looking at the face; pasaron apana — I forget myself; na jani ki duhkha pana — I know not what grief befell you; mora mukhe agi diya — putting fire in my mouth; sannyasa karili dinapana — you took sannyasa, a life of poverty

447When you called me 'Mother', it was wealth of hundreds of thousands to me —
looking at your face I forgot myself.
I do not know what grief befell you that, putting fire into my mouth,7
you took sannyasa, a life of poverty.

কতি গেলা তার পিতা, যাউ বিশ্বরূপ যথা,
ধরিয়া আনহ পুত্র ঘরে ।
যে বলুক সে বলুক লোকে, পুত্র আনি দেহ মোকে,
পুনঃ উপবীত দিমু তারে ॥ ৪৪৮ ॥

kati gelā tāra pitā, yāu biśbarūpa yathā,
dhariẏā ānaha putra ghare |
ye baluka se baluka loke, putra āni deha moke,
punaḥ upabīta dimu tāre || 448 ||

kati gela tara pita — where are you, his father; yau vishvarupa yatha — go where Vishvarupa is; dhariya anaha putra ghare — seize and bring the son home; ye baluka se baluka loke — let people say what they will; putra ani deha moke — bring the son and give him to me; punah upavita dimu tare — I shall invest him with the sacred thread again

448Where are you, his father? Go to where Vishvarupa is,
seize our son and bring him home!
Let people say what they will — bring my son and give him to me:
I will invest him with the sacred thread again."

জগন্নাথ বোলে বাণী, শুন দেবি শচীরাণী,
স্থির কর আপন অন্তর ।
শোক না করিহ আর, মিথ্যা সব সংসার,
বিশ্বরূপ সুপুরুষবর ॥ ৪৪৯ ॥

jagannātha bole bāṇī, śuna debi śacīrāṇī,
sthira kara āpana antara |
śoka nā kariha āra, mithyā saba saṃsāra,
biśbarūpa supuruṣabara || 449 ||

jagannatha bole vani — Jagannatha speaks; shuna devi shachirani — listen, goddess Shachi-rani; sthira kara apana antara — calm your heart; shoka na kariha ara — grieve no more; mithya saba samsara — all worldly life is vain; vishvarupa supurushavara — Vishvarupa is the best of worthy men

449Jagannatha replies: "Listen, goddess Shachi-rani,
calm your heart.
Grieve no more: all worldly life is vanity;8
and Vishvarupa is the best of worthy men.

আমার বংশের ভাগ্য, বিশ্বরূপ পুত্র যোগ্য,
আকুমার করিল সন্ন্যাস ।
এই আশীর্বাদ কর, সেই পথে হউক স্থির,
সন্ন্যাস করুক অনায়াস ॥ ৪৫০ ॥

āmāra baṃśera bhāgya, biśbarūpa putra yogya,
ākumāra karila sannyāsa |
ei āśīrbāda kara, sei pathe hauka sthira,
sannyāsa karuka anāẏāsa || 450 ||

amara vamshera bhagya — the fortune of our line; vishvarupa putra yogya — Vishvarupa, a worthy son; akumara karila sannyasa — took sannyasa without marrying; ei ashirvada kara — give this blessing; sei pathe hauka sthira — may he be steady on that path; sannyasa karuka anayasa — may he keep sannyasa without hardship

450It is the good fortune of our line: Vishvarupa, a worthy son,
has taken sannyasa without ever marrying.
Give him this blessing: may he be steady on that path
and keep his sannyasa without hardship.

সম্পদে বিপদ যেন, না মানিহ ইহা শুন,
শোক না করিহ অকারণ ।
একটি সন্ন্যাস করে, কোটি কুল নিস্তারে,
বিশ্বরূপ পুরুষরতন ॥ ৪৫১ ॥

sampade bipada yena, nā māniha ihā śuna,
śoka nā kariha akāraṇa |
ekaṭi sannyāsa kare, koṭi kula nistāre,
biśbarūpa puruṣaratana || 451 ||

sampade vipada yena — as misfortune amid good fortune; na maniha iha shuna — do not regard this, listen; shoka na kariha akarana — do not grieve without cause; ekati sannyasa kare — if one takes sannyasa; koti kula nistare — millions of generations are delivered; vishvarupa purusharatana — Vishvarupa is a jewel among men

451Listen: do not regard this as misfortune in the midst of good fortune;
do not grieve without cause.
If one takes sannyasa, millions of generations of the family are delivered —
Vishvarupa is a jewel among men."

শুনি জগন্নাথ-বাণী, পুনঃ কহে শচীরাণী,
কি কহিলে কহ মহাশয় ।
একটি সন্ন্যাস করে, কোটি কুল নিস্তারে,
ভাল কৈল আমার তনয় ॥ ৪৫২ ॥

śuni jagannātha-bāṇī, punaḥ kahe śacīrāṇī,
ki kahile kaha mahāśaẏa |
ekaṭi sannyāsa kare, koṭi kula nistāre,
bhāla kaila āmāra tanaẏa || 452 ||

shuni jagannatha-vani — hearing Jagannatha's words; punah kahe shachirani — Shachi-rani speaks again; ki kahile kaha mahashaya — what did you say, tell me, my lord; ekati sannyasa kare koti kula nistare — "if one takes sannyasa, millions of generations are delivered"; bhala kaila amara tanaya — my son has done well

452Hearing Jagannatha's words, Shachi-rani speaks again:
"What did you say? Tell me again, my lord.
'If one takes sannyasa, millions of generations are delivered'?
Then my son has done well."

এইমতে দুইজনে, হরিষ-বিষাদ মনে,
গোঙাইলা কথোক সময় ।
কি কহিব সে মহিমা, ভাগ্যপথে নাহি সীমা,
বিশ্বম্ভর পাইল তনয় ॥ ৪৫৩ ॥

eimate duijane, hariṣa-biṣāda mane,
goṅāilā kathoka samaẏa |
ki kahiba se mahimā, bhāgyapathe nāhi sīmā,
biśbambhara pāila tanaẏa || 453 ||

eimate duijane — thus the two; harisha-vishada mane — with joy and sorrow in their minds; gonaila kathoka samaya — passed some time; ki kahiba se mahima — what shall I say of that glory; bhagyapathe nahi sima — there is no limit to their fortune; vishvambhara paila tanaya — obtained Vishvambhara as their son

453Thus the two of them, with joy and sorrow in their hearts,
passed some time.
What can I say of that glory? There is no limit to their fortune:
they obtained Vishvambhara as their son.9

কহিল মুরারিগুপ্ত, দামোদর পণ্ডিত,
শুন বিশ্বরূপের সন্ন্যাস ।
পুনরপি পুছে কথা, বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা,
কহে এই এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৫৪ ॥

kahila murārigupta, dāmodara paṇḍita,
śuna biśbarūpera sannyāsa |
punarapi puche kathā, biśbambhara-guṇagāthā,
kahe ei e locanadāsa || 454 ||

kahila murari-gupta — Murari Gupta told; damodara pandita — Damodara Pandita; shuna vishvarupera sannyasa — hear of Vishvarupa's sannyasa; punarapi puchhe katha — again he asks for the story; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the song of Vishvambhara's glories; kahe ei e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

454So Murari Gupta told, and Damodara Pandita heard,
of Vishvarupa's sannyasa.
Again he asks for the story — the song of Vishvambhara's glories —
says this Lochana Dasa.

বিশ্বম্ভর হেনকালে, বসিয়া মায়ের কোলে,
নেহারয়ে বাপের বয়ান ।
কতি গেলা মোর ভ্রাতা, শুন শুন পিতা মাতা,
আমি তোর করিব পালন ॥ ৪৫৫ ॥

biśbambhara henakāle, basiẏā māẏera kole,
nehāraẏe bāpera baẏāna |
kati gelā mora bhrātā, śuna śuna pitā mātā,
āmi tora kariba pālana || 455 ||

vishvambhara henakale — at that time Vishvambhara; vasiya mayera kole — sitting on His mother's lap; neharaye bapera bayana — gazes at His father's face; kati gela mora bhrata — wherever My brother has gone; shuna shuna pita mata — listen, listen, father and mother; ami tora kariba palana — I will take care of you

455At that time Vishvambhara, sitting on His mother's lap,
gazes into His father's face:
"Wherever My brother has gone — listen, listen, father and mother:
I will take care of you."

এহেন শুনিঞা বাণী, জগন্নাথ শচীরাণী,
দোঁহে মেলি পুত্র কৈল কোলে ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ, পাশরিল যত দুঃখ,
এ কথা লোচনদাস বোলে ॥ ৪৫৬ ॥

ehena śuniñā bāṇī, jagannātha śacīrāṇī,
doṁhe meli putra kaila kole |
dekhi biśbambhara-mukha, pāśarila yata duḥkha,
e kathā locanadāsa bole || 456 ||

ehena shuniya vani — hearing such words; jagannatha shachirani — Jagannatha and Shachi-rani; donhe meli putra kaila kole — both together embraced their son; dekhi vishvambhara-mukha — seeing Vishvambhara's face; pasarila yata duhkha — forgot all sorrows; e katha lochanadasa bole — so says Lochana Dasa

456Hearing such words, Jagannatha and Shachi-rani
both together embraced their son;
looking at Vishvambhara's face, they forgot all their sorrows —
so says Lochana Dasa.

Thus ends the description of the Balya-lila.

✦

Notes

  1. The numbering of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition goes astray here: after 399 it prints 400, 401, 401 again, then the count returns to 393 and runs 393–403, after which it continues 404, 405… (and so on through the edition). Apparently the compositor was correcting the jump 330 → 340 of portion 12. To keep the edition's numbers, on which all further numbering depends, we retain the printed numbers and distinguish the repeats by a letter: the second "401" is 401a, the repeated series 393–401 is 393a–400a and 401b. The sequence of the couplets (confirmed by the 1983 and 1903 editions) is unchanged.
  2. Murari, an elder and respected man, prostrated himself before a child; by popular belief, an elder's bow to a younger one brings misfortune on the younger and shortens his life. Hence the parents' alarm and their plea that he bless Nimai with long life.
  3. Murari Gupta was a vaidya (physician) by caste; the parents respectfully call him a "shudra-muni", a sage who is not a brahmana.
  4. "Brahman, the Relisher of rasa" is Brahman as the Person who enjoys rasa (cf. Taittiriya Upanishad 2.7: "He, verily, is rasa"), that is, Krishna Himself. Advaita at once discloses to Murari that Nimai is the Lord Himself, but bids him keep it secret.
  5. Murari Gupta and Damodara Pandita are the narrator and his interlocutor in Murari Gupta's Sanskrit biography (Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita); Lochana Dasa, who relies on that work, adopts its frame. The story of Vishvarupa is in Murari 1.07.1–10.
  6. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding Vishvarupa is Sankarshana (in Murari, "a portion of Baladeva", 1.07.3). On taking sannyasa he received the name Shankararanya, and he left this world at Pandharpur (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 9.299–300).
  7. At a cremation it is the son who places fire in the mouth of the dead (mukhagni); Shachi says bitterly that by leaving, her son has as good as performed her funeral rite while she lives.
  8. That is, attachment to home and family is worthless; this is not a claim that the world is illusory, but a statement of the vanity of worldly life (samsara) beside renunciation for God's sake.
  9. In A this couplet was lost in the OCR (its number is restored from the neighbouring ones); the text follows the 1903 edition; the 1983 edition ends the stanza: "whose son is Gorachand".
